newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel zoning regulators target Arabs - report.
newsitem.headline: Israel zoning regulators target Arabs - report.

text.p: Almost all buildings demolished by Israeli regulators since 1993 for unlicensed construction belonged to Arabs, the Haaretz newspaper said on Thursday.
The newspaper, which examined Interior Ministry reports, said 90 percent of all illegal buildings razed in Israel and East Jerusalem in the last three years were constructed by Arabs.
It said however that Arabs were responsible for only 65 percent of all construction without a permit.
Giving one example, the study said zoning authorities in 1993 destroyed 257 of 551 buildings constructed without permission by Arabs but pulled down only 32 of 535 structures illegally built by Jews.

A ministry spokesman declined immediate comment. He said any ministry report on Israel's "Arab sector" grouped together the 800,000 Arabs in the Jewish state and some 160,000 Palestinians in Arab East Jerusalem.
Israeli Arabs, citizens of the country, have long complained of discrimination.

Israel captured East Jerusalem in the 1967 Middle East war and annexed it, a move the international community does not recognise. Arab residents say they find it almost impossible to obtain building permits.
